title: Business Analyst and Project Management- Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Consulting Support Services – Senior**
 CSS enhances Consulting project delivery by providing comprehensive project management, business analysis, and coordination support across the project lifecycle. The team is responsible for enabling successful project execution through governance, financial management, stakeholder engagement, reporting, risk management, requirements management, and delivery oversight across all Fields of Play.
   

  

 This role provides hands\-on exposure to both Business Analysis and Project Management disciplines, offering opportunities to work closely with business stakeholders, delivery teams, and senior leadership while developing expertise in consulting, transformation programs, and strategic initiatives.
   

  

 As a Business Analyst and Project Management professional, you will support organizations in defining business needs, analyzing processes, managing requirements, coordinating project execution, monitoring risks and dependencies, and ensuring solutions are delivered successfully to achieve intended business outcomes. You will play a critical role in driving collaboration between business and technology teams while maintaining focus on scope, quality, timelines, and value realization.
   

  

**K** 
**ey Roles and Responsibilities**
 Business Analysis Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead stakeholder discussions, requirements workshops, and discovery sessions to gather, analyze, document, and validate business, functional, and non\-functional requirements.
* Analyze business processes, operating models, workflows, and business rules to identify opportunities for improvement and transformation.
* Translate business requirements into clear functional specifications, user stories, process flows, and solution requirements.
* Collaborate with business and technology teams to align business objectives with technical capabilities and solution design.
* Conduct impact assessments, gap analyses, and process evaluations to support strategic decision\-making.
* Develop business cases, support proposal development, RFP responses, and identify data\-driven insights for client engagements.
* Facilitate user acceptance testing (UAT), validate solution outcomes, and ensure delivered solutions meet business requirements.
* Support change management, user adoption, training activities, and transition of solutions into business operations.


**Project Management Responsibilities**
* Support end\-to\-end project planning, execution, monitoring, and closure activities across multiple engagements.
* Manage project financial tracking, forecasting, budgeting, invoicing support, and reporting activities.
* Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, RAID logs, and status reports.
* Monitor project progress, identify risks and issues, coordinate mitigations, and escalate concerns when required.
* Facilitate governance forums, project review meetings, steering committee updates, and stakeholder communications.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams to ensure timely delivery of project objectives and commitments.
* Track resource utilization, capacity planning, and project dependencies across workstreams.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Commerce, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* Professional certifications such as PMP, CAPM, Prince2, Scrum Master (CSM/PSM), Agile, or equivalent are preferred.
* 8\-12 years of experience in Business Analysis, Project Management, Consulting, or Program Management support.
* Experience working with global stakeholders and cross\-functional teams in a consulting or professional services environment.
* Exposure to Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery methodologies.


**Technical Skills**
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and SharePoint.
* Experience with Power BI, Power Apps, Microsoft Project, Visio, and reporting tools.
* Working knowledge of Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Trello, or similar project management platforms.
* Understanding of business process modeling methodologies and workflow documentation.
* Familiarity with software development life cycles (SDLC), Agile frameworks, DevOps, product management, and requirements management practices.


**Professional Skills**
* Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, and communication skills.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and critical thinking capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in fast\-paced environments.
* Strong attention to detail with effective organizational and planning skills.
* Proven ability to influence, collaborate, and build trusted relationships across all organizational levels.
* Ability to independently drive initiatives while working effectively as part of a diverse team.
* Strong presentation, reporting, and executive communication capabilities.
* Demonstrated experience working with senior leadership and client\-facing engagements.
* Experience collaborating with business, technology, and leadership teams to drive strategic outcomes.
* Strong consulting mindset with focus on client service, problem\-solving, and continuous improvement.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: BCM-Business Analyst - Cards Senior-GDSF02
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Service line \- Position Title:**
 Senior Consultant – Cards and Payments Business Analyst
   

  

 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 Cards and Payments Functional Business Analyst
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* 5\+ years’ experience in banking payments transformations or implementing new cards and payment systems
* 3\+ Years of experience of working as Tech Business Analyst for Payment Processing Systems in large banks.
* Familiar with Payments messaging standards such as NACHA, ISO 8583, ISO 20022, SWIFT
* Proven experience as a Business Analyst or Technical Business Analyst in the payments or financial services domain.
* Strong understanding of payment systems, processing, and industry trends (e.g., ISO 20022, digital payments, payment gateways).
* Expertise in Cards Management platforms like HPS PowerCard, VisionPLUS, TSYS Prime
* Expertise in Enterprise Payment platforms like Finacle, Base24\.
* Proficiency in technical documentation and modelling tools (e.g., UML, BPMN).
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Familiarity with Agile methodologies and tools (e.g., Scrum, JIRA).
* Experience with API integrations and payment technologies.
* Knowledge of regulatory requirements in the payments industry.
* Certification in Business Analysis (e.g., CBAP) or Agile methodologies.
* Good Knowledge of check payments value chain involving Fraud and Dispute management, Clearing and Settlement processing, Network regulations and compliance.
* Demonstrable payment processing and clearing knowledge especially data mapping and modelling to support triaging issues raised in development and production
* Proven track record of working on multiple projects and change management initiatives in a fast\-paced and complex environment including liaising with external third\-party companies as necessary.
* Experience in stakeholder management and governance in large scale implementations.
* Sound knowledge of upstream and downstream systems in payments landscape like Core banking, Payment Switches, Compliance, FX, Advising, Billing etc.
* Knowledge about payments regulatory frameworks like SEPA, BASEL, PSD2, PCIDSS etc. is desirable
* Experience in working with payment processing stakeholders like Payment Intermediaries, Aggregators, Switches


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
 Skills and experience
   

  

* BE/BTech\+ MBA candidates with a minimum of 3 years of experience in client\-facing consulting roles
* Bring deep industry expertise in payments \& digital banking and large\-scale payments modernization programs
* Provide innovative ideas with our clients to explore disruptive strategies that create business value, including usage of new age technologies, such as Blockchain and AI.


 Behavioral Attributes:
   

  

* Analytical, organized, team player, relishes working in a multicultural, multi\-national business context.
* Strong delivery mindset, customer focus, commitment to results and high\-quality standards.
* Good communication skills, teamwork and customer focus are essential.
* Building influential relationships with colleagues, partners and customers is an essential part of the Services team strategy for success to date
* Being able to work independently or in a team as needed.
* Stakeholder engagement, management, and governance.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits**

**How to Apply**
